missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Милиционер' is masculine nominative as the subject of 'стоит'. 'На углу' is the prepositional location showing where he stands.
Strategic focus: Accusative equals genitive for animate masculine. 'Милиционера' takes the genitive-form accusative because the noun is animate masculine. 'Знакомого' agrees in the same form.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'О милиционере' uses the prepositional ending after 'о' to mean about the policeman. 'Спросили' marks the act of asking.

missions.phrase: На улице нет ни одного милиционера.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Genitive of negation. 'Милиционера' is the genitive after 'нет', and 'ни одного' reinforces the total absence. 'На улице' gives the place.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'От милиционера' takes the genitive after 'от' to mean from the policeman. 'Совет' is the accusative object received.

missions.phrase: Я подошёл к милиционеру за помощью.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Dative after preposition. 'К милиционеру' uses the dative after 'к' to mean toward the policeman. 'За помощью' is the instrumental purpose phrase.
Strategic focus: Dative recipient. 'Милиционеру' is the dative marking who receives the documents. 'Свои документы' is the accusative object of 'дал'.
Strategic focus: Instrumental with preposition. 'С милиционером' uses the instrumental after 'с' to mean talking with the policeman. 'Молодым' agrees in the masculine instrumental.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Милиционеры' is the nominative plural subject of 'дежурят'. 'На площади' is the prepositional location.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural after quantity. 'Милиционеров' is the genitive plural after 'нескольких', the animate accusative plural matching the genitive. The verb 'знаю' takes them as object.
